title: Start with a useful website
summary: A progressive web app starts as a working website.
introduction: A progressive web app starts as a working website. Your task: Open the basic page before adding a service worker.
learningObjectives: Open the basic page before adding a service worker.
Explain the example for start with a useful website

blocks.text: A progressive web app starts as a working website. Extra features should help even when installation or offline support is not available.

These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not hide the main content just because a browser has no install button.
